Maine’s line is commonly read as a general law that modern societies have exchanged inherited rank for freedom of contract. He was reporting a limited tendency, observed so far, in the private law of societies he called progressive: rights and duties fixed on a person had been moving from the family position they were born into toward obligations they assumed by agreement. “Status” there means only those family-based legal conditions, and “Contract” means duties whose source is agreement.

CONFIDENCE: 84
